title: GTA 6 Has a Canyon: Inside Mount Kalaga, Leonida's Wild National Park 🏞️ #Shorts
description:
Rockstar's official description of Mount Kalaga: "A national landmark up against the state's northern border, Mount Kalaga offers prime hunting, fishing, and off-road trails. In the lush surrounding backwoods, hillbilly mystics and paranoid radicals live far from the prying eyes of the government."

Fans think the canyon is based on Providence Canyon State Park in Georgia (fan theory reported by GTA BOOM; not confirmed by Rockstar). Florida's real highest point, Britton Hill, is 345 feet.

Source: rockstargames.com/VI (Only in Leonida: Mount Kalaga). Images: official Grand Theft Auto VI screenshots (Rockstar Games).

GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
